entries.title: Package source grammar, canonical identity and scoped local-path resolution
entries.what: Users can identify extension/resource packages with npm specifications, Git repositories with optional refs, or local files/directories. The parser determines cache identity and pin behavior before any install or settings mutation.
entries.interfaces: Source strings include npm:name[@version], npm:@scope/name[@version], git:host/owner/repo[@ref], explicit git:git@host:owner/repo[@ref], protocol Git URLs, relative/absolute/home/file-URL local paths. GitSource carries repo, host, path, optional ref and pinned. Stable identity must be reused by add/remove/update and scoped dedup; it must not silently turn a bare local name into an npm or Git source.

entries.title: Distribution identity, agent roots and bundled resource path resolution
entries.what: Every settings, resource and session consumer resolves a consistent distribution identity and directory tree, whether ICE runs from TypeScript, a package installation or a Bun binary. Environment overrides and resource assets have explicit path rules.

entries.title: Locked trust store with canonical ancestor inheritance and grouped updates
entries.what: Trust saved for a parent applies to descendants unless a closer folder overrides it. Saving a parent and clearing a child is one protected read-modify-write operation, and independent processes see current decisions.
entries.interfaces: `ProjectTrustDecision = boolean | null`; `ProjectTrustStoreEntry {path:string; decision:boolean}`; `ProjectTrustUpdate {path:string; decision:boolean|null}`. Methods `get(cwd)`, `getEntry(cwd)`, `set(cwd,decision)`, `setMany(updates)` are synchronous. JSON example: `{"/work":true,"/work/untrusted":false}`. Explicit nulls can be read but API null updates remove the key. No environment aliases or alternate trust schema are read.

entries.title: Tool path normalization and ordered read-path fallback
entries.what: Tool calls accept user-style paths and locate common macOS screenshot spellings while keeping write/edit destinations literal after normalization.
entries.interfaces: expandPath,resolveToCwd,resolveReadPath,resolveReadPathAsync,pathExists; harness normalizeToolPath,resolveToolPath,resolveReadToolPath. Shared normalizePath options {trim?,expandTilde?,homeDir?,stripAtPrefix?,normalizeUnicodeSpaces?}; tool callers enable stripAtPrefix and normalizeUnicodeSpaces. Inputs remain strings, and errors from file URLs or harness filesystem operations can reject the tool.

entries.title: Image signatures, conversion, resizing and coordinate hints
entries.what: Image reads attach supported content within model size limits, convert BMP when necessary, and tell the model how displayed coordinates map back to the original image.
entries.interfaces: detectSupportedImageMimeType(bytes) -> image/jpeg|image/png|image/gif|image/webp|image/bmp|undefined; processImage(bytes,mime,{autoResizeImages?}) -> {ok:true,data,mimeType,hints}|{ok:false,message}; resizeImage(bytes,mime,{maxWidth?,maxHeight?,maxBytes?,jpegQuality?}) -> {data,mimeType,width,height,originalWidth,originalHeight,wasResized}|null; formatDimensionNote(result). ReadImageProcessor returns base64 image content plus optional explanatory text. External dependency: @silvia-odwyer/photon-node WASM in TS; no network service is contacted by the image pipeline.

4 | export type ToolResultContent = TextContent | ImageContent;

6 | export interface NormalizeToolResultImagesOptions {
7 | 	/** Whether oversized images are resized to inline provider limits. Default: true */
8 | 	autoResizeImages?: boolean;
9 | }
10 | 
11 | /**
12 |  * Normalize image blocks returned by tool results.
13 |  *
14 |  * The `read` tool and `@file` CLI attachments run their images through `processImage`, but tools
15 |  * that produce images themselves (extensions, MCP bridges, screenshot tools) hand back arbitrary
16 |  * base64 payloads that go straight into session history and every subsequent provider request.
17 |  * Oversized images make the provider reject the whole conversation, not just the offending turn,
18 |  * so normalize them once as they enter history.
19 |  *
20 |  * Returns the original array when nothing changed so callers can skip rewriting the result.

entries.title: Tool-result image identity, failure policy and post-hook normalization
entries.what: Normalize tool-produced images once before their final history result, including images replaced by extension hooks. Preserve a tool's output and object identity when processing fails or makes no change.
entries.interfaces: ToolResultContent=TextContent|ImageContent; normalizeToolResultImages(content,{autoResizeImages?})→Promise<ToolResultContent[]>; result-array identity is an observable optimization signal to afterToolCall. No new RPC command, persistent file or network service.

entries.title: Validated release metadata and quiet automatic version checks
entries.what: Release lookup validates both the transport endpoint and returned package identity. Automatic checks quietly suppress failures while explicit lookup can return errors to the invoking command.
entries.interfaces: comparePackageVersions(a,b)→number|undefined; isNewerPackageVersion(candidate,current)→boolean; getLatestIceRelease(current,{timeoutMs?})→Promise<{version,packageName?,note?}|undefined>; getLatestIceVersion and checkForNewIceVersion; getIceUserAgent(version)→string. Environment: ICE_OFFLINE, ICE_UPDATE_URL, ICE_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK.

entries.title: Windows loaded dependency quarantine and deferred cleanup
entries.what: The TS npm self-update path moves loaded native dependencies aside so package replacement can proceed while the process is alive. Native executable activation has its own staged helper and does not require reproducing Node's module inventory.
entries.interfaces: cleanupWindowsNativeQuarantine(packageDir):void; quarantineWindowsNativeDependencies(packageDir):void. Persistent temporary path: nearest node_modules/.ice-native-quarantine/<timestamp>-<pid>-<uuid>/<package-relative-file>. Runtime inventory: process.report sharedObjects.

entries.title: Evaluation runner, explicit model defaults and separate test configuration
entries.what: A separate eval command chooses a default provider/model, launches only model-backed eval files, and keeps local unit tests distinct from those potentially authenticated runs.

entries.title: Task-bound session/source artifacts and scoped attachment persistence
entries.what: Evaluation runs attach their native session JSONL and generated source to the explicit test task, then persist only attachments belonging to the reported run.
entries.interfaces: Artifact types '@zykairotis/ice-evals:session' and '@zykairotis/ice-evals:source'; runId:string; attachments:[{name,contentType,body,bodyEncoding:'utf-8'}]|[]. Snapshot key iceSessionJsonl. Paths sessions/<sha256(runId)>/session.jsonl and sources/<sha256(runId)>/<basename>. recordEvalSessionArtifact(task,run), recordEvalSourceArtifact(task,runId,attachment), persistEvalArtifactReferences(artifacts,runId,artifactDirectory).

entries.title: Paired correctness lift, telemetry availability and diagnostic terminal summaries
entries.what: Comparison summaries pair each declared candidate only with its baseline, calculate correctness separately from efficiency, and expose missing/duplicate/error observations instead of filling them with zero.
entries.interfaces: HarnessObservation outcomes scored{score},unscored,skipped,pending,errored. HarnessComparisonReport{schemaVersion:1,evalSets:[{evalSet,comparisons}],diagnostics}. Each comparison has correctness{totalPairs,eligiblePairs,baselinePassRate,candidatePassRate,lift,baselineWins,candidateWins,ties} and three PairedMetricSummary records{totalPairs,eligiblePairs,baselineMean,candidateMean,meanDelta}. summarizeHarnessComparisons(observations); formatHarnessComparisonReport(report).
